readings.q, q1: as E258: per sampled changed member u of K* that may stand in (gain > 0, not a graft), alone: KL(F || F with u stood in, commute.stand_in, F's full forward) / KL(F || M), mean over the windows of D, at E248's saved gain (q) and at gain 1 (q1). rules.P_member: E258's: u passes when q1_u > floor and q_u <= tol x q1_u; u with q1_u <= floor is not counted; u with gain <= 0 or a graft fails with y = 0 (summed in full, not sampled).
